meta.name: gpt-taste
meta.description: Elite UX/UI & Advanced GSAP Motion Engineer. Enforces Python-driven true randomization for layout variance, strict AIDA page structure, wide editorial typography (bans 6-line wraps), gapless bento grids, strict GSAP ScrollTriggers (pinning, stacking, scrubbing), inline micro-images, and massive section spacing.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 打造高级UI动效与排版布局
copy.tagline_en: Create advanced UI animations and typographic layouts.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you pursue top-tier visual experience and GSAP motion design.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会生成符合 AWWWARDS 级别的前端代码，包括 GSAP 动画、无空隙的 Bento 网格、宽排版标题，并强制使用 Python 模拟随机化来避免重复布局。
howto.when: 当你要求 Claude 设计或生成网页 UI 代码时触发，尤其是需要高级动画、网格布局或创意排版时。

say.text: 帮我设计一个带 GSAP 滚动动画的落地页。
say.note: Claude 会生成包含滚动触发动画的页面。

say.text: 创建一个无空隙的 Bento 网格布局。
用 Python 随机化选择英雄区布局和字体。
say.note: Claude 会模拟 Python 随机选择来避免重复。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude generates AWWWARDS-level frontend code including GSAP animations, gapless Bento grids, wide typography headings, and enforces Python-driven randomization to avoid repetitive layouts.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to design or generate web UI code, especially when advanced animations, grid layouts, or creative typography are needed.

say_en.text: Design a landing page with GSAP scroll animations.
say_en.note: Claude will generate a page with scroll-triggered animations.

say_en.text: Create a gapless Bento grid layout.
say_en.note: Claude will use grid-flow-dense to ensure no empty spaces.

say_en.text: Use Python randomization to select hero layout and fonts.
say_en.note: Claude will simulate Python random choice to avoid repetition.
